ops.issue: 着物を is a direct object (を), but 'ao quimono vesti' reads as a dative ('to the kimono'), misrepresenting the particle in the structural mirror; lit_en correctly treats it as a direct object.

before.jp: お正月に着物を着た
before.kana: おしょうがつにきものをきた

structure_explanation.en: The structure is time + object + verb. お正月に indicates the moment ('at New Year'), with に marking the time and the prefix お giving a respectful/formal tone to 正月. 着物を marks the kimono as the direct object with を. The verb 着る (to wear) appears in 着た, the casual past form.

ops.issue: １０日 (10th day of the month) must be read とおか. The kana reads the digits as いちれい plus にち, which is not a possible Japanese reading of the date.
Romaji mirrors the wrong kana reading of １０日; should be tooka, not ichireinichi. (Distinct from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue.)
Token １０ in the date １０日 is read とお (part of とおか), never いちれい (digit-by-digit reading does not exist for dates).
Token 日 in １０日 (とおか) is read か, not にち; the expl even says the focus is reading dates, so the wrong reading directly teaches something false.

before.jp: 来月の１０日は休みだ
before.kana: らいげつのいちれいにちわやすみだ

structure_explanation.en: It is a sentence A は B だ: the topic 来月の１０日 (the 10th of next month) is marked by は and identified as 休み (a day off/break). The の links 来月 (next month) to １０日 (the 10th). だ is the casual copula 'is'. The focus is reading dates with a time reference (来月).
structure_explanation.pt-BR: É uma frase A は B だ: o tópico 来月の１０日 (o dia 10 do próximo mês) é marcado por は e identificado como 休み (folga/descanso). O の liga 来月 (mês que vem) a １０日 (dia 10). だ é a cópula casual 'é'. O foco é a leitura de datas com referência temporal (来月).

translation_literal.en: As for the 10th of next month, it is off (a holiday).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto ao dia 10 do mês que vem, é folga.

translation.en: The 10th of next month is a day off.
translation.pt-BR: Dia 10 do mês que vem é folga.
